costScope: Whole unrestricted recipient support. Gross historical costs retained; identifiable aid value removed only for non-in-kind accounting proxy, not cash flow. Donated clinician and patient resources incomplete. Scholarships remain costed and non-health benefit unquantified.
geographicAttribution: Official program and return describe nationwide domestic services and no foreign operations. Conditional g=.99 allows incidental nonresident benefit; range.98–1. USA includes residents of50states and DC. Headquarters location and citizenship are not allocation keys.
formula: D=sum[t=1..T]((1−m)/1.03)^t. N=(G/c)×b. Q_all=N×(s×u×p×D−h). Q_USA=Q_all×g. Price per10=10G/Q_USA only if positive. b is financing/provider/manufacturer additionality; s is benefit not otherwise obtained; p is sustained effective use; u is utility gain while using devices. h is an adverse-burden allowance retained for all additional fittings even when s=0. Numerical inputs are retained alpha diagnostic judgments; no beta central inputs are established.
counterfactual: The financial screen makes otherwise-unmet need plausible but does not prove no alternative care. s allows Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, veterans' programs, other charities, family purchase or suitable OTC options. b separately discounts existing sponsorship, fixed donated-device quotas, provider slots and reserves. The alpha c attempted to include failed applications and administration through a whole-recipient cost anchor, but its completed-fitting denominator is unverified. p discounts post-fitting use rather than counting completion twice.
attribution: No extra hearing gain is credited to both scholarship and standard-program recipients. Scholarship cash and awareness receive no assumed health benefit but remain in cost; their separate benefits are unquantified. Each recipient is counted once, not once per device. Clinical priors transfer from external trials with better follow-up, not from device retail values. The main uncertainty is donation-sensitive completed care, so numerical cases are conditional and do not establish a favorable bound.
uncertainty: Central withdrawn: both completed-care denominator supporting c and donation-induced device/provider capacity supporting b lack calibration. This is unknown, not zero. Clinical priors support diagnostics only.
nativeOutcomes: Annual services claim >120 people; completed new fittings unknown. Schedule M aid contribution/item counts 178/164/164; manufacturer says 100–150 aids annually plus scholarship aids. No linked completion or inventory ledger.

inputs.name: c
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic only. The earlier $3,000 completed-fitting cost and 60% financing/capacity additionality reproduce the alpha calculation, but the annual new-fitting denominator and gift-induced capacity are not established. Low reserves do not calibrate marginal output.

inputs.name: b
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic only. The earlier $3,000 completed-fitting cost and 60% financing/capacity additionality reproduce the alpha calculation, but the annual new-fitting denominator and gift-induced capacity are not established. Low reserves do not calibrate marginal output.

inputs.name: s
inputs.unit: fraction of benefit not otherwise available
inputs.rationale: Alpha diagnostic prior only, not beta central. Last-resort screening supports targeting; allow30% alternative access/benefit. Range0–.9. OTC alternatives do not cover all ages/severities.

inputs.name: u
inputs.rationale: Alpha diagnostic prior only, not beta central. One-third of Singapore.12 short-term HUI difference, discounted for modified scoring and generic-US composite nulls. Stress0–.10; not an HHIE-to-QALY mapping.

inputs.name: p
inputs.rationale: Alpha diagnostic prior only, not beta central. Allows nonuse, partial use, poor fit, maintenance and limited follow-up. Range.5–.9. Not a measured recipient adherence rate.

inputs.name: T
inputs.rationale: Alpha diagnostic prior only, not beta central. Conditional four-year benefit; evidence supports three-year communication effect and program allows application everyfiveyears, but that is not proof of durability. Range1–5.

inputs.name: m
inputs.rationale: Alpha diagnostic prior only, not beta central. Broad mixed-age allowance; actual age mix absent. Range.01–.04; no mortality benefit credited.

inputs.name: h
inputs.rationale: Alpha diagnostic prior only, not beta central. Small acclimation/discomfort/adverse burden allowance, not an observed serious-harm rate; test0–.002. Retained when alternative benefit offsets hearing gains.

inputs.name: g
inputs.rationale: Alpha diagnostic prior only, not beta central. Domestic mission and operations; outcome-weighted residence unknown. Range.98–1.
